notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4706814/5b8a7704503fbc362503da2af903ca5be27f1e82.jpg

Hey Clan Wars crew,

Just stopping by to let you know we've just added a custom Hat & Building Editor to Worms W.M.D as part of another free update to the game!

This free update gives all players the ability to create, share and use their own designs for both Worm hats and usable buildings via the Steam Workshop. The Hat & Building Editor works alongside the already implemented World Editor.

Not only that but Worms W.M.D is currently 66% off on Steam, so if you fancy checking out the spiritual successor to Worms Armageddon there’s never been a better time.

Check out the Worms W.M.D Steam Store page here and join the party.

notes.title: Worms W.M.D Release Date and All-Stars Pre-Order Pack Announcement!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/01b52f07f59ec05132eb6136cd28886d8255a50c.jpg

I want to start by thanking everyone for their support and enthusiasm for Worms W.M.D, it’s been nothing short of amazing. And now I’m super happy to announce that you’ll be able to get your hands on Worms W.M.D when it launches August 23rd. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/327030/

But that’s not all…

We’re celebrating the launch of Worms W.M.D by gathering up our friends from across gaming for the Worms W.M.D All-Stars Pre-Order.

All gamers pre-ordering the game before its August 23rd launch will receive the following Worms W.M.D All-Stars content:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/53fe3101ed7520c111a4f15c4730c2f4cd9ec066.png
Worms fans worldwide are eager to cause mayhem with the all-new, mega-powerful Tank in Worms W.M.D., but wait until they get their hands on the Rocket League Octane Battle-Car! Soccer meets driving meets Worms. What's not to like? 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/389dc6d93f6775005157aa52d295946876a8c2e4.png
Use the Goat-on-a-Rope weapon to strike fear into the hearts of your enemies as the goat swings around the gorgeous digitally painted 2D landscapes using its sticky tongue to hone in on them! Laugh maniacally as the homicidal maniac with hooves explodes, turning your opponents’ troops into worm meat! We also have a pretty cool Goat Simulator three mask set. Because, why not?

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/398c5a82f34250edaa6f22dfa10085f108579854.png
It’s Payday time for the worms. Stick it to the man by dressing your invertebrate chums up in the masks that have become iconic for millions of PAYDAY 2 fans around the world and plan your attack looking like a total badass. They’ll never take you alive!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/a8424b93fe3d1c62be3a2d887a6b11046352bc6e.png
The most outrageous, over-the-top action franchise in videogames, arrives in Worms W.M.D in the form of the Dubstep gun from Saints Row IV. This baby can inflict massive damage whilst making pedestrians (and worms) dance. Yes, dance. Team17 is proud, and slightly nervous, to announce that the Dubstep Gun will be bringing the dance-pocalypse as one of our mounted guns in honour of this awesome weapon.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/85a3d67f49416d5659a0a77a121799ba71374a2e.png
The free-to-play zombie survival sensation, where millions of users try their best to stay alive, shuffles into Worms W.M.D in search of brains! And in homage to this popular zomb-fest, Worms fans can dress their slimy pals in a three mask set and wage war in an Unturned mission.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/aa4bfc8437646b11c277d87977949460b0eb41e2.png
Coming to the explosive rescue of worms everywhere is the fan favourite Broforce Turkey Bomb, bringing the pain in Worms W.M.D. And that’s not all! The Liberty Strike is a Broforce flavoured airstrike which will rain down fiery hell from the skies. Booyah!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/dc5d2b3dd18267fda21a0b8715ce52a591e5788a.png
The War Mage and Sorceress have vowed to protect the world and guard the rifts. But sometime after the last great battle, trouble is brewing again. Whilst we wait for the Orc Invasion, we can dress our worms up in this Orcs Must Die! three mask set and unleash the excellent crafted minions weapon. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/2ed7e07b19bf5534eba34a2a6d065dd7bbf70da9.png
Dress your worms up as one of gaming’s most anticipated double acts with the awesome Yooka-Laylee seven mask set!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/03a738b9e2cf0bec42389fc5f2d846499941e09a.png
A three mask set from the award-winning 2015 hit The Escapists is a must-have accessory for all wormy wannabe escapists. And if you want somewhere different to escape to, there’s a new mission waiting for you. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1461348/43858b4dbc47fd2f4c2b84a73554c8dc1de9c36c.png
Ahhhh, precious memories of mutually-assured worm destruction! Don’t you just wish you could re-live them? We’ve got you covered! Unleash the Ming Vase, Sheep Launcher and Kamikaze weapons, get stuck into five classic missions and head into battle in a classic Worms three mask set!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18939040/9dfbb66eb946d85f72cda0c30c5eecc68b443eb2.png
TF2 brings the worm pain with the devastating Sentry Gun weapon and nine mask set featuring the full TF2 crew of Pyro, Demoman, Medic, Spy, Soldier, Scout, Sniper, Heavy and Engineer. 

See all of this in action in the All-Stars Pre-Order Trailer
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kb0vMfcE9-o

Stop by the Worms W.M.D forum to let us know what you think of the All-Stars Pre-Order. And if you liked the announcement please give it a big thumbs up!

notes.title: Worms Clan Wars Update - 24/10/13
notes.notes:
An update to Worms Clan Wars has been released. The update will be applied automatically. This will update your game to show version number #0147 in the Main Menu. This patch is 174.2MB.

This update includes:
•	Optimised physics calculations to reduce load on CPU
•	Optimised shaders throughout the game
•	Improved performance on Intel-based graphics cards
•	Multiple changes and improvements to the single player Story experience
•	Improved AI thinking time as a result of player feedback
•	Fixed an issue where lobbies with multiple rounds was causing an issue with matchmaking
•	Fixed an issue where accepting an invite could result in being placed into an empty lobby
•	Players can now choose to zoom smoothly with the mouse wheel, rather than step through three levels of zoom
•	Players can now view Player Stats in local multiplayer games during a guest or AI turn
•	Fixed a rare issue where clan and community points weren't been recorded correctly
•	Fixed an exploit where a certain weapon could allow use of weapons in retreat time
•	Ninja Rope will now attach correctly to cavern borders
•	Changed shock range and damage cap for the Cluster Bomb 
•	Parachute can now be deployed from a Jetpack
•	Worm Charm can now be toggled between states on the jetpack
•	Changes to the way Worm Charm works. Dropping a Worm Charm now no longer ends a turn.
•	Dropping a secondary weapon from the Aqua Pack no longer ends the turn
•	Fixed an issue where having [Caps Lock] engaged resulted in shift symbols being displayed
•	Worms Firepunching into indestructible terrain will no longer become stuck in it
•	Turn timer no longer stays on zero after using the teleport gun and equipping another weapon
•	Grenade launched from a utility is now fired using the [Enter] key
•	Hangman's hat no longer acts as a moustache

notes.title: Worms Clan Wars Update - 30/09/13
notes.notes:
An update to Worms Clan Wars has been released. The update will be applied automatically. This will update your game to show version number #0121 in the Main Menu.

This update includes a number of major optimisations and adds support for the Speech Bank Editor.

Optimized rendering of font and HUD elements 
Optimized and reduced overall texture and geometry memory needs.
Optimized OpenGL utilization.
Fixed a number of GPU memory corruption issues.
Improved asset and resource management and loading times.
Optimized sprite rendering

Apologies for the large download size. We have had to modify the base resources, which means the new assets have be downloaded in a patch.

Voice chat icons in a clan match will now appear in the correct place
The correct leaderboard will now be displayed at the end of a Worm Ops mission
Further improvements to WormNet

notes.title: New patch with framerate improvements and other goodies!
notes.notes:
Update #2 released 23/08/2013

Optimisation and Framerate Fixes:

Improved the vertex buffer object systems for vertex data 
Optimisation pass to remove redundant state changes and unnecessary functions calls in rendering layer
Altered kick-off point for water calculations to not stall the gameplay update


New Scheme Options: 

Hot seat time can now be changed between 0, 3 and 5 seconds.
Indestructible Terrain can now be toggled on or off. 
Jet pack full can now be changed between high, medium and low.
Max crates per turn can be switched between 0, 1, 2 and 3.


General Fixes:

Washing machine bug: Reduced prevalence of instances where worms become stuck in a moving pool of dynamic water (still an issue though – we’re working on it!)
Fixed an issue where Steam Workshop content wasn’t appearing if files were set to read-only. 
WormNet now correctly reports the number of players and active games in a channel. 
Fixed an issue where subscribed landscapes were not visible without at least one user landscape. 
You can now change worm loadout and team colour using a gamepad.
Fixed an issue in WormNet where cancelling joining a lobby could take a long time. 
Fixed an issue where the player could become stuck in the landscape editor. 
Options changed after scrolling with the right mouse button are now correctly saved.
